title: Pocketwire Rewards Boost Offer Terms and Catalogue
content:
A Pocketwire Rewards boost is activated by the member in the app from the boost offer catalogue below, and adds boost points to qualifying purchases at the offer's merchant. The tier figures named here are the tier's open boost limit, qualifying purchases per activation, most boost points on one purchase, boost validity and swap cooldown.

## Boost offer catalogue

| Offer code | Merchant | Boost rate (points per USD) | Offer maximum (points) |
|---|---|---|---|
| BOOST-FRESHMART5 | FreshMart | 5 | 750 |
| BOOST-BLUEBIRD10 | Bluebird Coffee | 10 | 300 |
| BOOST-ZIPLINE3 | Zipline Rides | 3 | 450 |
| BOOST-STREAMLY20 | Streamly | 20 | 400 |
| BOOST-NORTHWAY4 | Northway Fuel | 4 | 600 |
| BOOST-PATTY15 | Patty Shack | 15 | 500 |

## Terms

1. A boost can be activated only while the member's open boosts are fewer than the tier's open boost limit. An open boost is an activation whose validity has not ended and whose uses, counted as boost entries with the same offer code since the activation, are fewer than the tier's qualifying purchases per activation. On single-slot tiers a new boost excludes any other until the current one is used or expires.
2. A slot freed by use or expiry reopens only after the tier's swap cooldown in full hours.
3. An activated boost stays valid for the tier's boost validity in calendar days, the activation date being day 0, and applies to the next qualifying settled purchases at the offer's merchant made after the activation moment, up to the tier's qualifying purchases per activation. A purchase made before activation is never boosted.
4. Boost points are the purchase amount multiplied by the offer's boost rate, rounded down to whole points and capped at the lower of the offer maximum and the tier's most boost points on one purchase.
5. Boost points add to the purchase's base and category points rather than replacing them. They do not count toward the monthly earning cap or the category bonus cap.
6. Only one boost can apply to one purchase; when two open boosts match the same purchase, the one activated first applies.
7. A boosted purchase earns boost points only once: boost points are credited only if no earlier boost entry points to the same card purchase, so a missing boost is credited only when the activation, the merchant match and the timing all hold and no boost entry exists for that purchase.

## Worked examples (hypothetical purchases)

| Offer | Tier cap on one purchase | Purchase | Uncapped boost | Cap applied | Boost points |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BOOST-STREAMLY20 | 750 | 15.99 USD | 319.8 | lower of 400 and 750 is 400 | 319 |
| BOOST-STREAMLY20 | 750 | 25.00 USD | 500 | lower of 400 and 750 is 400 | 400 |
| BOOST-PATTY15 | 500 | 40.00 USD | 600 | lower of 500 and 500 is 500 | 500 |

Cooldown example (hypothetical): on a tier with a 24-hour swap cooldown, a boost used at 10:00 on a Monday frees its slot, and a new boost can be activated in that slot once 24 full hours have passed, at 10:00 on the Tuesday.

## Points of judgement

- A purchase at Bluebird Coffee made one hour before the member activated BOOST-BLUEBIRD10 is not boosted.
- The member activates the boost; the activation is the member's own step in the app.
